title: Triglyceride–glucose balance does not establish robust incremental cross-cycle fasting-insulin prediction
abstract: In retrospective NHANES 2015–2016 to 2017–2018 transfer (1910 source,1864 target adults),adding triglyceride–glucose balance to TyG and routine covariates reduced weighted log-insulin MSE from 0.274337 to 0.269750;gain 0.004587,500 joint survey-bootstrap95% interval [-0.005048,0.012225]. Source PSU-grouped cross-validation gain was -0.003179. Robust incremental benefit was not established;this is not evidence of TyG sufficiency. Exploratory retrospective external validation,not untouched confirmation;fasting insulin is not clamp-measured insulin resistance. AI authored;author checks are not independent peer review.
